title: PIXL 8000 Blue Magic Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Magic from PIXL 8000 delivers an unexpected twist with its combination of juicy Blueberry, aromatic Aniseed and a streak of cool Menthol. This flavour balances sweetness with a herbal edge and refreshing finish, making it a great option for vapers after something distinctive. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine delivery. Paired with a 10ml refill reservoir, this setup allows for up to 8000 puffs per kit when used with the PIXL 8000 device. With mesh coil technology for consistent flavour and a simple push-fit design, this pod is ready for effortless MTL vaping. Insert the pod, tap twice to boost vapour, and enjoy the layered profile. Blue Magic is part of the wide PIXL 8000 flavour range built for variety and ease.
